create.name: Bronwen Logan
create.bio:
Bronwen Logan is one of the foundational voices of modern reiki — co-author of The Reiki Sourcebook, the field’s standard reference work, and the woman whose warm Australian voice has carried the practice into countless ears as the narrator of its best-loved audiobooks. Practising and teaching since 1999, she co-founded the International House of Reiki with Frans Stiene and created the Shibumi International Reiki Association, co-writing the books that shaped a generation’s understanding of the system’s Japanese roots: The Japanese Art of Reiki, Your Reiki Treatment, The A-Z of Reiki, and her own Beginning Reiki, Beginning Healing — with her guided audio Reiki Meditations for Self-Healing published by Sounds True.

Today her home for everything is Reiki with Bronwen, run from Tomah Retreat in Australia’s Blue Mountains, where she teaches privately — in person and online — alongside her many rescue animals. Her focus is twofold and quietly radical: the system of Reiki from its traditional Japanese perspective, and raising the voices of women within the teachings, a mission she champions through the Reiki Women Podcast, which she co-founded. Her offerings have a devotional rhythm all their own: a weekly online Reiju blessing (“fifteen minutes a week to remember who you really are”), a fortnightly coaching group, her Shinpiden+ programme for serious practitioners and teachers, self-study webclasses, and the Shūyō app — her daily reiki companion of Japanese meditations, poetry contemplation, and precept recitation, guided by her own voice. Scholarly without stiffness, nurturing without softness lost, Bronwen is the practice’s great woman of letters — and of the spoken word.

books.title: Beginning Reiki, Beginning Healing
books.author: Bronwen Logan
books.description: Bronwen's gentle introduction for people taking their first steps with Reiki. It explains what Reiki is, how it supports healing and how to begin your own practice with confidence. It's available as an ebook and as an audiobook narrated by Bronwen.

books.title: Gratitude in Motion: A Reiki Practitioner & Teacher Guide
books.author: Bronwen Logan
books.description: A short, beautifully pared-back guide to gratitude, the foundation of the Reiki Precepts. It offers practical daily exercises that suit everyone, with special sections on bringing gratitude into Reiki practice and teaching. Keep a journal handy.

books.title: Reiki Meditations for Self-Healing
books.author: Bronwen Logan
books.description: A guided audio programme from Sounds True in which Bronwen leads traditional Japanese Reiki meditations for energy and vitality. Her calm voice makes it easy to build a daily self-healing practice. It's a much-loved companion for practitioners at any level.

courses.title: Shinpiden+ with Bronwen | On-Demand
courses.description: Bronwen's signature programme for serious practitioners and teachers who have completed Reiki III in any lineage. It includes 60 video lessons (about 800 minutes of teaching), 29 quizzes, a participant manual and community access. You need to apply and be accepted before enrolling.

courses.title: Online Reiju with Bronwen | Weekly
courses.description: A live 15-minute Reiju blessing on Zoom every week, which Bronwen calls "fifteen minutes a week to remember who you really are". It's for students who have completed Reiki I, II or III and want ongoing spiritual support.

courses.title: Online Reiki Coaching Group | Fortnightly
courses.description: A one-hour live circle on Zoom, held twice a month, for Reiki practitioners worldwide. Sessions revisit the foundation practices and the Japanese roots of the system, and each one includes Reiju. Recordings stay available for a month.

courses.title: The Shūyō App: Your Daily Reiki Companion
courses.description: Morning and evening Reiki self-practice guided by Bronwen, in 10- or 25-minute versions, alongside weekly waka poems, precept chanting in Japanese and gentle reminders. It runs in any browser or on any phone, and you can cancel at any time.

courses.title: Waka Wisdom: 21 Days of Imperial Reiki Meditations | On-Demand
courses.description: A self-paced 21-day course built around the waka poems of Emperor Meiji and Empress Shōken. Each day pairs a poem with contemplative questions, an omikuji (a shrine oracle reading) and a guided meditation. It suits practitioners at any level.

courses.title: The 7 Gratitudes: A Journey Through Japanese Spiritual Wisdom in Just 10 Minutes a Day
courses.description: A seven-day on-demand course of ten-minute lessons on gratitude in Japanese spiritual wisdom. It's an easy daily practice that roots you in the heart of the Reiki Precepts.

courses.title: The 7 Quiets: Some Shhhh for Just 10 Minutes a Day
courses.description: A week of short guided practices for finding inner stillness. Ten minutes a day is enough to bring calm back into a busy life.

courses.title: The 7 Mothers: Develop Strength, Courage and Bravery in Under 10 Minutes a Day
courses.description: Seven days of short practices that build inner strength, courage and bravery. They draw on Japanese spiritual wisdom and fit into under ten minutes a day.

courses.title: The 7 Serenities: A Path to Calm and Relaxation in Just 10 Minutes a Day
courses.description: A seven-day series of practical techniques for calm, relaxation and harmony. Each session takes ten minutes and gives you a tool you can use for life.

courses.title: The 7 Slumbers: Gentle Japanese Tales for Drifting Off to Sleep
courses.description: Seven gentle Japanese stories, told by Bronwen, to help you drift off to sleep. It's a soothing bedtime ritual from the warmest voice in Reiki.

courses.title: Shoden Reiki I — Get the Most Out of It (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass that deepens your understanding of Shoden, the first level of Reiki. It suits both new students and anyone revisiting the foundations.

courses.title: Okuden Reiki II — Get the Most Out of It (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass to help second-level students get the most from Okuden's teachings and practices.

courses.title: Shinpiden Reiki III — Get the Most Out of It (Webclass)
courses.description: A focused recorded webclass on the teachings of Shinpiden, the third (teacher) level of Reiki.

courses.title: Healing with the Eyes, Mouth and Hands (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass on three traditional Japanese ways of sharing Reiki: through the eyes, the breath and the hands.

courses.title: Finding Your Hara: Finding YOU (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass that reconnects you with the hara, your energetic centre, and with your true self.

courses.title: The Japanese Art of Animal Reiki (Webclass)
courses.description: Bronwen shows how to share Reiki with animals, drawing on her life at Tomah Retreat with her many rescue animals.

courses.title: Mudras: The Magico-Spiritual Language of Hands (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass on mudras, the sacred hand gestures, and how they work in Reiki and in everyday life.

courses.title: The Three Diamonds (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass on the Three Diamonds, Earth, Heaven and Heart, a foundational concept of Japanese Reiki.

courses.title: For Today Only (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass on the Reiki Precepts and the heart of daily practice.

courses.title: Why Touch is Integral to the System of Reiki (Webclass)
courses.description: A recorded webclass explaining why hands-on healing is essential to the traditional system of Reiki.

courses.title: Reiki with Children (Webclass)
courses.description: A practical recorded webclass on sharing Reiki with children safely and joyfully.

free_resources.title: Waka Wisdom, Day 1 (free lesson)
free_resources.description: The first day of the Waka Wisdom course, free and open to all. It pairs Emperor Meiji's waka "The Spacious Sky" with seven contemplation prompts and a guided practice of repeating the poem for up to 30 minutes. It's a lovely first taste of Japanese Reiki meditation.
